scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && esbuild ./server/production.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --target=node22.12 --outfile=./dist/server/production.js
scripts.test:e2e:deployment: npm run test:e2e:deployment:dev && npm run test:e2e:deployment:production
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
